app.name: Campulator
app.tagline: Find campsites. Compare spots. Camp smarter.

search.title: Search
search.selectCriteria: Pick criteria; all criteria have equal weight

filters.title: Filters
filters.needLocation: Location permission is required for the distance filter

add.title: Add Place
add.loginRequired: You need to log in to add a place.
add.verifyRequired: Verify your email first to add a place (you can resend it from the Profile tab).
add.locationHint: Tap the map to mark the location
add.precisionApproxNote: With approximate location the real coordinate is hidden; a 500 m area is shown on the map.
add.photoNote: Photos are optional; the place is published with a "Photo pending" label. You can add photos from the place detail once published.
add.successPending: Place sent for moderation review. It will go live once approved.
add.duplicateWarning: Similar place(s) found nearby — moderators will check for duplicates:
add.error: Submission failed. Check your connection and try again.
add.duplicateLive: Similar place(s) already exist here — make sure you are not adding a duplicate:

saved.title: Saved
saved.placeholder: Collections and saved searches coming in Phase 7

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestNote: You are browsing as a guest. An account is required to add places, review, rate, and use collections.
profile.guestFootnote: Explore, search, and Smart Match work as a guest too.

avatarError.generic: Could not upload the photo. Please try again.

password.title: Change password
password.note: Changing your password signs you out on all devices; you will need to log in again with the new password.
password.success: Password changed. Please log in again.
password.hintRequired: Enter your current and new password.
password.AUTH_PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password must differ from the old one.
password.AUTH_PASSWORD_NOT_SET: This account uses social login; no password is set.
password.generic: Could not change the password. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.warning: Your account is closed permanently. Your name and profile details are erased, and your collections and saved searches are removed. Places and reviews you added remain, anonymised. This cannot be undone.

verify.explanation: Tap the link we emailed you; it opens the app and verifies your account. If the link does not work, enter the code from the email manually.
verify.invalid: The code is invalid or expired. Resend it and try again.
verify.resendFailed: Could not send the email. Please try again.

onboarding.page1Body: Discover camping, caravan, picnic, and barbecue spots on the map.
onboarding.page2Body: Score spots with CampScore, compare side by side, pick the best.
onboarding.page3Body: Pick your criteria; we rank the best-matching campsites by percentage.

auth.guestNote: No login needed for exploring, searching, and details. An account is required for favorites, reviews, and contributions.
auth.consentText: By signing up you accept the Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, and Community Rules.
auth.marketingConsent: I want to receive campaign and announcement emails (optional)
auth.verificationSent: Verification email sent. Verify your email to contribute.

errors.AUTH_EMAIL_IN_USE: An account with this email already exists.
errors.generic: The operation failed. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the API. Check that the server is running and the address is correct.

hints.required: Fill in the fields to continue.
hints.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
hints.name: Display name must be at least 2 characters.

detail.actionsComingSoon: Save, directions, and compare will be enabled in later phases

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.empty: No reviews yet — be the first!
reviews.replyOfficialPlaceholder: Write your official reply on behalf of the business...

compare.title: Compare
compare.hint: Pick at least 2 places (max 3) from place details to compare.

collections.title: Collections
collections.empty: No collections yet. Create one via "Save" on a place detail.
collections.dragHint: Press and hold the handle to reorder

route.title: Directions
route.permissionDenied: Location permission is required for directions.
route.error: Could not calculate the route. Check your connection.
route.approximateNote: This place has an approximate location; the route targets the center of the 500 m area.
route.estimateNote: Distance and time are estimates; real route data will be used once a maps API key is configured.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emailSoon: Email notifications will be added in a later phase.

PLACE_APPROVED.body: The place you added passed moderation.

PLACE_REJECTED.title: Your place was not published
PLACE_REJECTED.body: The place you added was rejected in moderation.

REVIEW_HELPFUL.title: Your review was helpful
REVIEW_HELPFUL.body: Someone marked your review as helpful.

TRUST_LEVEL_UP.title: Your trust level increased
TRUST_LEVEL_UP.body: Your contributions unlocked a new level.

business.claimHint: Moderators review your claim. Once approved you can post official replies to reviews of this place.
business.evidencePlaceholder: Evidence of ownership (tax number, licence, contact details, etc.)
business.claimPending: Your ownership claim is under review
business.verifiedOwner: You are the verified owner of this place

errors.BUSINESS_CLAIM_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: You already have a claim for this place.
errors.BUSINESS_PLACE_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Another ownership claim already exists for this place.
errors.generic: Could not submit the claim. Please try again.

contribute.title: Contribute to this place
contribute.hint: If something is missing or wrong, the community fixes it. Your suggestions go live after moderation.
contribute.verifyRequired: Verify your email first to contribute (you can resend it from the Profile tab).
contribute.error: Could not submit. Check your connection and try again.
contribute.notePlaceholder: Describe what is wrong and what it should be (at least 10 characters)
contribute.noteHint: Write at least 10 characters so moderators can assess it.

sent.change: Your suggestion was sent to moderation. You will see the outcome in notifications.
sent.report: Your report was submitted. Moderators will review it.
sent.verified: Thank you! Your contribution was recorded.
